<!-- Rendered by targets::tar_make(). Every number and every figure below comes
     from a pipeline target; nothing is computed in this document except
     formatting and the Figure 1 flow diagram, which is drawn from the `flow`
     target in reports/_thesis_assets.R. If a number is wrong, the fix belongs
     in R/, not here. -->

```{r setup}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gtsummary)
library(knitr)

targets::tar_source(here::here("R"))
source(here::here("reports", "_thesis_setup.R"))

# _thesis_assets.R may live in reports/ (alongside _thesis_setup.R) or in R/
# (where tar_source has already loaded it). Source it only if it is not
# already loaded, so the document works either way and never sources twice.
if (!exists("fig_manifest", inherits = TRUE)) {
  source(here::here("reports", "_thesis_assets.R"))
}

tar_load(c(
  # tables
  table_one, desc_numbers, flow, model_coefficients, tbl_loo,
  model_diagnostics, moran_residual, mechanism_table, mechanism_concordance,
  i63_engine_table, control_table, pollutant_selection, aq_ranks,
  sensitivity_coefficients, deprivation_resolution, deprivation_stability,
  appendix_b, appendix_b_adapted, session_tbl, stroke_subtypes,
  # figures
  fig_pollution_pair, fig_pollution_shared, fig_excess_map, fig_excess_flagged,
  fig_rr_map, fig_exceedance, fig_forest, fig_mech_facets, fig_mech_exceedance,
  fig_hub_time, fig_i63_exceedance, fig_i63_raw, fig_rr_compare,
  fig_concordance, fig_controls
))
```

```{r export-pngs}
# Writes every manifest figure to output/thesis/ as a 300 dpi PNG at thesis
# dimensions, so the figures can also be placed by hand in Word if the DOCX
# layout is not wanted.
exported <- export_thesis_figures(env = environment())
```

Every numbered item below corresponds to a placeholder in the thesis. Captions
are written for the thesis rather than copied from `thesis_results.qmd`, so they
can be pasted directly; each carries the pipeline target it came from.

Figures are also written individually to `output/thesis/` at 300 dpi and full
text width (190 mm), via the project's own `save_figure()`.

Read **Notes and unresolved items** at the end before inserting anything.

---

# Results

## Table 1

```{r tbl-1}
thesis_table(
  table_one, "1",
  paste("Table 1. Characteristics of avoidable deaths, ATS Milano residents aged 0-74 years, 2022-2024. Columns are mutually exclusive, age is median (IQR), all other cells are n (column %)."),
  "table_one")
```

## Table 2

```{r tbl-2}
desc_numbers$by_mechanism |>
  mutate(deaths = fmt_num(deaths, 1), pct = fmt_pct(pct)) |>
  thesis_table(
    "2",
    paste("Table 2. Avoidable deaths by the service function that could have averted them. Weighted counts: a death from a cause split equally between two mechanisms contributes 0.5 to each."))
```

## Table 3

```{r tbl-3}
tbl_loo |>
  mutate(across(c(elpd_loo, se_elpd, p_loo, looic, elpd_diff, se_diff),
                \(x) fmt_num(x, 1))) |>
  thesis_table(
    "3",
    paste("Model comparison by approximate leave-one-out cross-validation,",
          "ordered best first. Higher expected log predictive density is",
          "better. The difference and its standard error are computed on",
          "paired pointwise differences."),
    "tbl_loo")
```

### Table 3b (optional, or appendix)

```{r tbl-3b}
model_diagnostics |>
  mutate(across(c(rhat_max, ebfmi_min), \(x) fmt_num(x, 4)),
         pct_divergent = fmt_pct(pct_divergent)) |>
  select(model, rhat_max, ess_min, n_divergent, pct_divergent, ebfmi_min) |>
  thesis_table(
    "3b",
    paste("Convergence and sampler diagnostics, M1-M7. Supports the",
          "convergence sentence in the Results, which currently quotes the",
          "maximum R-hat and minimum effective sample size without a table."),
    "model_diagnostics",
    col_names = c("Model", "Max R-hat", "Min ESS", "Divergent", "% divergent",
                  "Min E-BFMI"))
```

### Table 3c (optional, or appendix)

```{r tbl-3c}
moran_residual |>
  mutate(across(c(statistic, post_mean, post_low, post_high),
                \(x) fmt_num(x, 3)),
         p_value = fmt_p(p_value)) |>
  select(model, statistic, p_value, post_mean, post_low, post_high) |>
  thesis_table(
    "3c",
    paste("Moran's I on Pearson residuals, M1-M7. This is the table behind",
          "the residual autocorrelation sequence quoted in the Results, which",
          "is the argument for the spatial specification."),
    "moran_residual",
    col_names = c("Model", "Moran's I", "p", "Posterior mean I", "2.5%",
                  "97.5%"))
```

# Notes and unresolved items

**N1. Figure 2 now resolves to a pipeline target.** An earlier reading of the
rendered HTML concluded there was no pollution figure; that was wrong. The
pipeline builds both `fig_pollution_pair` (free scales, each pollutant's own
pattern) and `fig_pollution_shared` (one common legend). The shared-scale
version is used above, because the claim the Methods actually make is that PM2.5
varies less across the territory than NO2 does, and on free scales that
difference is invisible. Neither is rendered in `thesis_results.qmd`, which is
why the figure appeared to be missing.

**N2. The DAG is still not in the pipeline.** It is the one Methods figure with
no target and no source file. Exporting it from dagitty and adding it as a
static file target would put it under version control with everything else.

**N3. Table 5's placeholder caption in the thesis says "the three modelled
strata"; `mechanism_table` returns seven.** Corrected in the caption above.

**N4. Thesis Table 6 is labelled "Model or negative controls", but the Results
prose in that section quotes the specification ladder, not the control panel.**
Both are needed: the ladder is Table 6 and the control panel Table 7 above. This
pushes the suggested concordance table to Table 8.

**N5. The "discontinuity around 30-35 minutes" sentence.** Figure 10 is the plot
it refers to. The claim is made in prose with no estimate behind it; if it is
kept, `tracer_per_10min` or a spline term would be the way to support it.

**N6. Appendix C now has content.** `deprivation_stability` was already in the
pipeline but not rendered anywhere, which is why the 2011-to-2023 stability
numbers in Methods had no table behind them. Tables C1 and C2 above are that
table.

**N7. Cross-check the I63 count.** `stroke_subtypes` and
`outcome_feasibility_table` should agree on the number of I63 deaths. Figure 1
takes its count from `stroke_subtypes` so that the exclusions shown sum to the
total; if the feasibility table disagrees, the discrepancy is upstream and worth
resolving before submission.

**N8. Table 1 and Table 2 count service functions differently.** `tbl_one()`
assigns each death a single combined `mechanism_any` label, so a split cause
appears as "Screening + Tertiary prevention"; `desc_numbers$by_mechanism` splits
the weight across both. Both are defensible, but on facing pages the difference
reads as an error. Add a footnote to Table 1, or drop its service-function block
since Table 2 covers it.
